description: Erection of additional floors at roof level and erection of rear extensions at second floor level, on top of the existing back additions to both properties at no. 91 and 93 Hammersmith Road; infilling of the existing window and installation of a new window relocated to the rear of no. 93 Hammersmith Road, replacement of the existing window with a new high level window and installation of a new window opening to the rear of no. 91 Hammersmith Road at second floor level.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

415-06 Rev B; 415-07 Rev B; 415-08 Rev B;; 415-09 Rev B
415-10C REV A; 415-10B REV A; 415-10A; 415-10D


To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Dormers: Clad in lead.
Windows: Timber-framed sliding sash windows, painted white.
Mansard Roof Slopes: Finished in natural or artificial grey slate tiles (70 degree pitch).
Rear Second-Floor Extensions & Party Walls: London stock brickwork to match the existing building.
The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 
Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions hereby permitted. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - No part of any roof of the existing building or the extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to any elevation of the application property to form access onto the roofs.

The use of any roof as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - No external air-conditioning units, ventilation fans, extraction equipment, flues, or associated external pipework/ducting shall be fitted to the exterior of the building other than the vertical wall-mounted kitchen air extraction duct shown on the approved drawings.

 To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and prevent harm to neighbouring residential amenity, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, and H11 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 7 - Prior to commencement of the development hereby permitted, a Construction Logistics
Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council. This must be in
accordance with requirements of the council's pro-forma template and Transport for
London (TfL) requirements and should seek to minimise the impact of construction
traffic on nearby roads and restrict construction trips to off-peak hours only. Thereafter,
the works shall be carried out and fully implemented and maintained throughout the
construction phase of the development in accordance with the approved Construction
Logistics Plan unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To minimise the impacts of construction-related vehicle movements and
facilitate sustainable construction travel to the site in accordance with policies T1 and
T6 of the Local Plan (2018).
